 assert len(res.target_disassembly)==len(res.candidate_disassembly)==718

  rows.append({'index':index,'offset':a.offset,'size':a.size,'target':a.text,'candidate':b.text,'native_raw':native[a.offset:a.offset+a.size].hex(),'candidate_raw':obj.data[b.offset:b.offset+b.size].hex(),'audited_native':left.hex(),'audited_candidate':right.hex(),'masked_external_fields':masked})
